title: add RAG agent quickstarts + tool-calling examples and docs site updates
author: Aisha Khan
release_notes: Added RAG agent quickstarts, tool-calling examples for Python/TS, and docs site pages for RAG templates and agent best practices. Backwards-compatible docs-only change.
body:
Motivation: provide opinionated, tested quickstarts and example playbooks for Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and agent-style tool-calling so engineers can get production-ready integrations faster. This PR adds several short quickstarts (Python + TypeScript), curated RAG prompt templates, an agents/tool-calling examples folder, and corresponding docs site pages.

Summary of changes: (1) docs/quickstarts/rag-agent-quickstart.md - step-by-step RAG agent quickstart with config snippets, caching recommendations, and rollout notes; (2) examples/agents/rag-agent-playbook/ - Python and TS runnable examples demonstrating tool-calling (search, question-answer, and external API invocation) with explicit retry/fallback policies; (3) docs/templates/rag-templates.md - a small library of vetted prompt templates and evaluation notes; (4) docs/site navigation updates to include the new quickstarts and templates; (5) updated CI examples/fast tests to include basic smoke tests for examples.

Checklist: 
- [x] Add quickstart and example code (Python + TS)
- [x] Add docs site pages and navigation entry
- [x] Include basic smoke tests that run in CI
- [x] Add short HOWTO for tool-calling via the SDKs
- [x] Validate sample prompts with local eval harness

Commits (high-level):
- add: docs/quickstarts/rag-agent-quickstart.md (step-by-step quickstart + config)
- add: examples/agents/rag-agent-playbook/python/{README.md,main.py,requirements.txt} (search + QA + tool call)
- add: examples/agents/rag-agent-playbook/ts/{README.md,index.ts,package.json} (TS SDK example)
- add: docs/templates/rag-templates.md (prompt templates + eval notes)
- chore: docs/site/sidebar and nav updates to surface quickstart pages
- test: examples smoke test in ci/examples-smoke.yaml

Files changed (high level):
- docs/quickstarts/rag-agent-quickstart.md (new)
- docs/templates/rag-templates.md (new)
- docs/site/sidebar.yaml (modified)
- examples/agents/rag-agent-playbook/python/main.py (new)
- examples/agents/rag-agent-playbook/python/README.md (new)
- examples/agents/rag-agent-playbook/python/requirements.txt (new)
- examples/agents/rag-agent-playbook/ts/index.ts (new)
- examples/agents/rag-agent-playbook/ts/README.md (new)
- examples/agents/rag-agent-playbook/ts/package.json (new)
- ci/examples-smoke.yaml (new)
- docs/snippets/tool-calling-sdk.md (new)
- docs/images/rag-flow.png (new, small diagram)
- tests/examples/test_rag_agent_smoke.py (new, quick smoke test)
- examples/agents/.gitkeep (added to ensure folder)

Design notes: The quickstart shows a recommended configuration for Redwood Dedicated/Hosted consistency: pinning model versions, enabling KV prefix caching for repeated context, and an autoscaling-safe batching config. The tool-calling examples explicitly demonstrate: (1) registering a search tool that queries our embedding-backed vector store; (2) a simple web-api tool for fetching external data with timeouts; (3) a reranker flow to improve precision on short lists. The Python example focuses on the SDK usage pattern common to customers; the TypeScript example mirrors the same flow and highlights streaming/tool-calls via the TS SDK.

CI and testing: The examples smoke test runs a lightweight integration: installs deps, runs the Python/TS example in a sandbox mode (mocked vector store), and asserts the agent completes a single iteration without throwing. One flaky test (examples smoke: ts-install) failed on first CI run due to transient cache/network; CI was re-run and all checks passed. Full CI matrix: linters (pass), unit tests (pass), examples-smoke (pass after rerun).

Review conversation (highlights):
- Ben Williams: "Thanks, really useful — left one comment about making the retry policy configurable in the example (timeout vs retry count). Also can we add a line about cost implications of long context windows in the quickstart?"
- Aisha Khan: "Responded: added config options and a short note in quickstart about cost/latency tradeoffs and suggested token limits for the examples."
- Maya Patel: "Can we include an explicit example of canary rolling for agents that use external tools? Small suggestion: include a note on safe fallbacks when tool calls fail."
- Aisha Khan: "Added a small subsection on rollouts and fallback strategies (fallback to a generation-only mode) and a short test that simulates a tool failure path."
- Liam O'Connor: "Approved after minor nits around README wording."

Merge: Squash-and-merge. Merge commit message summarises the quickstarts and examples added and references ENG-2142.

Notes for docs reviewers: The new docs pages are intentionally short and actionable — they link out to more comprehensive best-practices (batching/caching/quantization) rather than duplicating content. If we want expanded examples (multi-tool orchestrations, multi-step agents) we should add follow-up PRs that build on these playbooks.
